description: List the meeting types on a Cal.com account by name (with account timezone). The event_type_id that configure_integration takes for provider="calcom" is one of the ids listed here. Requires the secret_key from create_trial_tenant, either as the secret_key argument or an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header.

api_key.description: The Cal.com API key to look up meeting types for.

secret_key.description: The secret_key returned by create_trial_tenant, if your client can't send it as an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header instead.

name: list_calcom_event_types
title: List Cal.com Event Types
